notes: OpenCode 2.x, driven through the service API (#2109 P5a smoke cell). ready → working → ready on one service-hosted ses_… session, with the turn ended by the 2.x plugin's hook. Birth is not pinned to ready (P4 first sampled an API session as working). The ready → working → ready bounce the store's late idle row causes after a hook turn end (#2115) is anchored past, not asserted against (#2109 §6 Q2 default).

text: The API session is admitted when its first activity lands (P3, #2107): a ses_… transcript_new. Its first state is not pinned — P4's 1 Hz sampler first saw an API session as working, so V1's 'born ready within 2s' is not assumed
The session binds to the one running 2.x service (pid.go servicePIDFor) — there is no client process
The prompt drives the ses_… session to working; a no-tool turn never waits
The 2.x plugin's session.execution.succeeded reaches the daemon (recorded as the canonical Stop hook)
The turn completes back to ready on the same session
